long.title: Why Are 3 Million Seniors Losing Their Health Plans?
long.desc:
Nearly 3.2 million Americans in Medicare Advantage must pick a new plan for 2027 because their plan is being discontinued, including about 1 million from Humana (about 600,000) and UnitedHealthcare (about 390,000), as CBS News reported on October 23, 2026. We go through what Medicare Advantage is, why insurers say they are cutting (higher costs, more use of care, lower federal payments), why critics say the program is still overpaid (MedPAC: about 14% more than traditional Medicare), what the Medicare agency (CMS) says, who is hit hardest (rural counties, people with high costs, prescriptions), and the key dates: open enrollment Oct 15 - Dec 7, a special window to the end of February if your plan ends, and the Medigap guaranteed-issue window.

General information only, not medical, legal or financial advice. Check medicare.gov or your state's free SHIP counselling program for your own situation. Ruth, Dave and Linda are made-up characters. Real people are shown as generic labelled stick figures; quotes are attributed as reported.
